name: spending-ring

frames.best_why: Groceries sits under the marker with its total, share and a green drop versus last month.

tagline: Spin a spending donut and it settles with one category's total under the marker.
summary: A monthly spending donut chart you can spin like a dial. Each slice that passes the top marker takes over the centre, showing its name, amount, share and change.
appearance: A dark rounded card holds a multicoloured donut ring with a small dark marker at the top, a large amount and percentage in the middle, and a two-column legend of coloured dots and rounded totals below.
behaviour: Dragging around the ring turns it and dims unselected slices while the centre readout swaps to whatever sits under the marker. A flick coasts on a spring and settles, and clicking a legend row turns straight to it.
demo_content: October spending $2,748.42 split across Housing, Groceries, Shopping, Dining out, Transport and Subscriptions.
search_phrases: spending donut chart you can spin
drag the wheel to read a slice
use_when: A finance dashboard wants a compact category breakdown that people can explore by spinning.
avoid_when: The ring needs several categories to read; with one or two slices the spin feels pointless and the gaps look odd.
customise: Title, the category array of amounts, change and colour classes, and the currency are props; ring size, gaps and spring are constants.
weight_why: One SVG ring and a short spring loop that stops once the dial settles.

a11y.note: The ring is a labelled slider with arrow keys and a legend of buttons; the delta relies on colour plus an arrow for meaning.

issues: Unselected slices drop to 40% opacity, which makes the overall breakdown hard to compare.
polish_why: The dial spring and centre readout feel good; the legend is compact and legible.
title: Spending Ring
